local busy = {} -- [Player] = true while claiming
local initialized = false

-- RebirthService is required lazily (it may depend on this module) to avoid

local rebirthService = nil
local rebirthTried = false

local function getRebirthService()
	if rebirthService or rebirthTried then

	local module = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild("RebirthService")
	if not module then

local function isFree(entry)

end

-- Normalize an incoming plot table into the single shared shape (done once).
local function normalize(p, i)
	p.index = p.index or i
	p.theme = p.theme or p.Theme or PlotThemes.getTheme(i)
	if typeof(p.origin) ~= "CFrame" then

	baseColor: Color3,
	emitter: ParticleEmitter,
	tween: Tween?,
}

local function isFiniteNumber(v: any): boolean
	return type(v) == "number" and v == v and v ~= math.huge and v ~= -math.huge

local function pitchForTier(tier: number): number
	local fn = Cfg.pitchForTier
	if type(fn) == "function" then
		local ok, res = pcall(fn, tier)
		if ok and isFiniteNumber(res) then
			return res
		end
	end
	return math.clamp(1 + 0.12 * (tier - 1), 0.5, 2)
end

local function findCollector(pos: Vector3): CollectorInfo?
	local best: CollectorInfo? = nil
	local bestDist = 25
	for i = #collectors, 1, -1 do
		local info = collectors[i]
		if info.part.Parent == nil then
			table.remove(collectors, i)
		else
			local d = (info.part.Position - pos).Magnitude
			if d < bestDist then
				bestDist = d
				best = info
			end
		end
	end
	if best == nil and pos == Vector3.zero and #collectors > 0 then
		best = collectors[#collectors]
	end
	return best
end

	local part = info.part
	if part.Parent == nil then

	if info.tween then

	part.Color = FLASH_COLOR
	local tween = TweenService:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(FLASH_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {

	info.tween = tween
	tween:Play()
	info.emitter:Emit(4)

-- Resolve a verified sound id from the GameAssets sound table (Coin, Pop, ...).
-- Falls back to the given id if GameAssets or the entry is missing.
local function normalizeId(value: any): string?
	if type(value) == "number" then
		return "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(math.floor(value))
	elseif type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then
		return value
	end
	return nil
end

local function resolveSound(name: string, fallback: string): string
	local resolved: string? = nil
	pcall(function()
		local moduleScript = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GameAssets") or ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameAssets", 5)
		if not moduleScript then
			return
		end
		local ga = require(moduleScript)
		if type(ga) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local tbl = ga.Sounds or ga.SOUNDS or ga.sounds or ga.SoundIds or ga.SOUND_IDS or ga.soundIds
		if type(tbl) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local entry = tbl[name]
		if type(entry) == "table" then
			resolved = normalizeId(entry.id or entry.Id or entry.ID or entry.SoundId or entry.soundId or entry[1])
		else
			resolved = normalizeId(entry)
		end
	end)
	return resolved or fallback
end

--!strict
-- TutorialService: server owner of first-60-seconds tutorial state.
-- Creates the 'TutorialStep' RemoteEvent at require time; other services call notify().

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local TutorialConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("TutorialConfig"))
local ForgeTelemetry = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry"))

local EVENTS = TutorialConfig.EVENTS

-- One place that creates the remote.
local remote: RemoteEvent
do
	local existing = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(TutorialConfig.REMOTE_NAME)
	if existing and existing:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		remote = existing
	else
		remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		remote.Name = TutorialConfig.REMOTE_NAME
		remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end
end

type State = {
	fired: { [string]: boolean },
	done: boolean,
	startedAt: number,
}

local states: { [Player]: State } = {}

-- Ordered events the server drives; each fires at most once and only in order.
local ORDER = { EVENTS.CLAIMED, EVENTS.CASHED, EVENTS.BOUGHT }

local TutorialService = {}

local function numberFrom(inst: Instance?): number
	if inst and (inst:IsA("IntValue") or inst:IsA("NumberValue")) then
		return (inst :: IntValue).Value
	end
	return 0
end

-- Rebirths are stored in the 'Rebirths' leaderstat; owned upgrades are tracked
-- on the player as the 'UpgradesOwned' attribute (0 if nothing is recorded yet).
local function hasRebirthed(player: Player): boolean
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if stats and numberFrom(stats:FindFirstChild("Rebirths")) > 0 then
		return true
	end
	local attr = player:GetAttribute("Rebirths")
	return type(attr) == "number" and attr > 0
end

local function ownedUpgrades(player: Player): number
	local attr = player:GetAttribute("UpgradesOwned")
	if type(attr) == "number" then
		return attr
	end
	return 0
end

local function isActive(player: Player, state: State?): boolean
	if not state or state.done then
		return false
	end
	if os.clock() - state.startedAt > TutorialConfig.TOTAL_SECONDS then
		state.done = true
		return false
	end
	return player.Parent == Players
end

function TutorialService.notify(player: Player, eventName: string)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state or not isActive(player, state) then
		return
	end
	local nextEvent: string? = nil
	for _, name in ORDER do
		if not state.fired[name] then
			nextEvent = name
			break
		end
	end
	if nextEvent == nil or eventName ~= nextEvent then
		return
	end
	state.fired[eventName] = true
	if eventName == EVENTS.BOUGHT then
		-- last server-driven step; client handles the SHOP step locally
		state.fired[EVENTS.BOUGHT] = true
	end
	ForgeTelemetry.count("tutorial_steps", 1)
	remote:FireClient(player, eventName)
end

local function setup(player: Player)
	if states[player] then
		return
	end
	local state: State = { fired = {}, done = false, startedAt = os.clock() }
	states[player] = state

	task.spawn(function()
		-- leaderstats may not exist yet; wait briefly, then give the client time to load.
		player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", 5)
		task.wait(1.5)
		if states[player] ~= state or player.Parent ~= Players then
			return
		end
		if hasRebirthed(player) or ownedUpgrades(player) >= TutorialConfig.SKIP_UPGRADES then
			state.done = true
			remote:FireClient(player, EVENTS.SKIP)
			return
		end
		remote:FireClient(player, EVENTS.START)
		-- The plot is auto-claimed shortly after joining, so the "walk to a CLAIM gate"
		-- step would contradict the game. Advance to step 2 right away
		-- ("Watch your dropper make cash"). notify() counts tutorial_steps and is
		-- ignored if a manual claim already advanced the step.
		TutorialService.notify(player, EVENTS.CLAIMED)
	end)

	task.delay(TutorialConfig.TOTAL_SECONDS + 2, function()
		if states[player] == state then
			state.done = true
		end
	end)
end

local started = false

function TutorialService.start()
	if started then
		return
	end
	started = true
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		states[player] = nil
	end)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		setup(player)
	end
end

return TutorialService

--!strict
-- ForgeTelemetry: tiny counter API for generated games. ForgeProbe reports these counters.
--
--   local ForgeTelemetry = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").ForgeTelemetry)
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("coins_collected")      -- +1
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("damage_dealt", 25)     -- +25
--   ForgeTelemetry.get()                          -- { coins_collected = 1, damage_dealt = 25 }
--
-- Counters live as number attributes on ServerStorage.ForgeCounters (a Folder), so every VM in the
-- server (game scripts, ForgeProbe, execute_luau) sees the same values. Server only: on the client
-- count() is a no-op and get() returns {}.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local FOLDER_NAME = "ForgeCounters"

local ForgeTelemetry = {}

local function folder(): Instance?
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return nil
	end
	local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local f = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = FOLDER_NAME
		f.Parent = ServerStorage
	end
	return f
end

-- Attribute names: letters, digits and underscores, max 100 chars, may not start with "RBX".
local function key(name: string): string
	local k = string.gsub(tostring(name), "[^%w_]", "_")
	if k == "" then
		k = "_"
	end
	if string.sub(k, 1, 3) == "RBX" then
		k = "_" .. k
	end
	return string.sub(k, 1, 100)
end

function ForgeTelemetry.count(name: string, n: number?)
	local f = folder()
	if not f then
		return
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		local k = key(name)
		local cur = f:GetAttribute(k)
		local add = tonumber(n) or 1
		f:SetAttribute(k, (if type(cur) == "number" then cur else 0) + add)
	end)
	if not ok then
		-- telemetry must never break the game
		return
	end
end

function ForgeTelemetry.get(): { [string]: number }
	local out: { [string]: number } = {}
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return out
	end
	local f = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		return out
	end
	for k, v in f:GetAttributes() do
		if type(v) == "number" then
			out[k] = v

local function billboardText(bb: BillboardGui): string

	for _, d in bb:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then
			table.insert(parts, d.Text)
		end
	end
	return table.concat(parts, " ")

local function billboardPart(bb: BillboardGui): BasePart?

		return bb.Adornee
	end
	if bb.Parent and bb.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
		return bb.Parent
	end
	return nil

local function parseCost(text: string): number?
	local num, suffix = string.match(text, "%$%s*([%d%.,]+)%s*([KkMm]?)")
	if not num then
		return nil
	end
	local n = tonumber((string.gsub(num, ",", "")))
	if not n then
		return nil
	end
	suffix = string.upper(suffix)
	if suffix == "K" then
		n *= 1000
	elseif suffix == "M" then
		n *= 1e6
	end
	return n
end

local function ownedByMe(inst: Instance): boolean
	local cur: Instance? = inst
	while cur and cur ~= Workspace do
		for _, v in cur:GetAttributes() do
			if v == player.UserId or v == player.Name or v == player.DisplayName then
				return true
			end
		end
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	return false
end

local function nearest(list: { BasePart }, from: Vector3): BasePart?
	local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
	for _, p in list do
		local d = (p.Position - from).Magnitude
		if d < bestD then
			best, bestD = p, d
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function findGate(): BasePart?
	local hrp = getHrp()
	local from = hrp and hrp.Position or Vector3.zero
	local list = {}
	for _, d in Workspace:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BillboardGui") and d.Enabled then
			local part = billboardPart(d)
			if part and partVisible(part) and string.find(billboardText(d), "^%s*Claim") then
				table.insert(list, part)
			end
		end
	end
	return nearest(list, from)
end

local function findCollector(): BasePart?
	local hrp = getHrp()
	local from = hrp and hrp.Position or Vector3.zero
	local mine, all = {}, {}
	for _, d in Workspace:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and string.find(string.lower(d.Name), "collector") then
			table.insert(all, d)
			if ownedByMe(d) then
				table.insert(mine, d)
			end
		end
	end
	return nearest(#mine > 0 and mine or all, from)
end

	local anchor = findCollector()
	local hrp = getHrp()
	local origin = anchor and anchor.Position or (hrp and hrp.Position) or Vector3.zero
	local best, bestCost, bestD = nil, math.huge, math.huge
	for _, d in Workspace:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BillboardGui") and d.Enabled then
			local part = billboardPart(d)
			if part and partVisible(part) then
				local text = billboardText(d)
				if not string.find(string.lower(text), "rebirth") then
					local cost = parseCost(text)
					local dist = (part.Position - origin).Magnitude
					if cost and dist < 120 and (cost < bestCost or (cost == bestCost and dist < bestD)) then
						best, bestCost, bestD = part, cost, dist
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local StarterPlayer = game:GetService("StarterPlayer")

local sps = StarterPlayer:FindFirstChild("StarterPlayerScripts")
if not sps then error("setup: no StarterPlayerScripts") end
local s = sps:FindFirstChild("TutorialGuide")
if not s then error("setup: no TutorialGuide script") end
local ok, src = pcall(function() return s.Source end)
if not ok or type(src) ~= "string" or #src == 0 then
	error("setup: cannot read TutorialGuide source: " .. tostring(src))
end

local lower = string.lower(src)

-- Only look at the part of the script from the step-advance code onward is too brittle;
-- scan the whole script for the feedback ingredients.
local hasSound = string.find(lower, "sound", 1, true) ~= nil
local hasPop = string.find(lower, "pop", 1, true) ~= nil
local hasSparkle = string.find(lower, "sparkle", 1, true) ~= nil
	or string.find(lower, "particleemitter", 1, true) ~= nil
	or string.find(lower, "particle", 1, true) ~= nil

local good = hasSound and hasPop and hasSparkle
return {
	ok = good,
	detail = string.format(
		"TutorialGuide source %d chars; sound=%s pop=%s sparkle/particle=%s (all must be true for step-completion feedback)",
		#src, tostring(hasSound), tostring(hasPop), tostring(hasSparkle)
	),
}
